title: Self-dual higher spin theory: Poincaré invariance and new solutions
summary: In this paper we study the self-dual higher spin theory in $4d$ recently proposed in arXiv:2209.01966. The typical vacuum of higher spin theories is an empty AdS space-time. We consider solutions of special form: space-time geometry associated with spin $S=2$ field is an AdS, and other fields may have nonzero values, such that the global space-time symmetry of the vacuum is broken to $3d$ Poincaré.
